description: This file defines a React component for a comprehensive AI Model, Agent, and MCP server hub dashboard, including data fetching, modals, and various UI elements.

methods.name: showModal
methods.description: Sets the state to display the model details modal for a selected model.

methods.name: showAgentModal
methods.description: Sets the state to display the agent details modal for a selected agent.

methods.name: showMcpModal
methods.description: Sets the state to display the MCP server details modal for a selected MCP server.

methods.name: goToPublicModelPage
methods.description: Navigates to the public model hub page URL.

methods.name: handleMakePublicPage
methods.description: Shows the modal to select models to make public.

methods.name: handleMakeAgentPublicPage
methods.description: Shows the modal to select agents to make public.

methods.name: handleMakeMcpPublicPage
methods.description: Shows the modal to select MCP servers to make public.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies given text to clipboard and shows a success notification.

methods.name: formatCapabilityName
methods.description: Formats support capability keys into user-friendly title case strings.

methods.name: getModelCapabilities
methods.description: Extracts and returns support capability keys marked as true for a given model.

methods.name: formatCost
methods.description: Formats a number as a dollar amount representing per million tokens cost.

methods.name: handleMakePublicSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes model data after successful public operation.

methods.name: handleMakeAgentPublicSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes agent data after successful public operation.

methods.name: handleMakeMcpPublicSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes MCP server data after public operation.

methods.name: handleFilteredDataChange
methods.description: Updates the filtered data state based on user filtering actions.
